lines.text: Zedekiah becomes king at twenty-one, reigns eleven years in Jerusalem, does evil, and rebels against the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem with a siege wall, famine grows severe, and the men of war flee by night.
The Chaldeans overtake Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and at Damascus the king of Babylon kills his sons and blinds him.
Nebuzaradan burns the house of the LORD and the palace, and the Chaldeans rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

wrong_details.wrong: the Chaldeans rebuild the walls of Jerusalem
wrong_details.true: the whole army of the Chaldeans broke down all the walls around Jerusalem

lines.text: Evil-merodach pardons Jehoiachin, speaks kindly to him, and gives him a daily portion until the day of his death.
